article.story: ROCK HILL, S.C. ( -- — Samuel Hincapie scored 24 points as North Dakota beat Winthrop 93-90 on Saturday. Hincapie added seven rebounds for the Fightin’ Hawks (1-1). Luke Winkel scored 16 points and added six assists. Andrija Radojevic shot 4 of 6 from the field and 7 of 7 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. Spence Sims finished with 25 points for the Eagles (0-2). Winthrop also got 15 points, six rebounds and four assists from Anthony Smith III. Keshawn Fisher also had 15 points and three steals. Up next Up next for North Dakota is a Monday matchup with Clemson on the road, and Winthrop visits Kennesaw State on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
